[Context: DSA conducted by the World Bank and the IMF, where two shock scenarios were analyzed. The most]
extreme shock is a 30 percent one-time depreciation in 2015, which does not lead to a breach of the debt
sustainability threshold. The second is an increase in debt to 10 percent of GDP that mimics a financial
sector shock leading to domestic debt-financed bank recapitalization needs. Under this shock, the present
value of the public debt-to-GDP ratio rises to a peak of 29 percent in 2015, again staying well below the
